parrafo.es: Mini Company Landscaping lleva anos transformando patios en todo Miami-Dade: camas de jardin, palmas y arboles, piedra decorativa y mantenimiento de cesped, con el mismo cuidado en cada visita. Respaldado por la calificacion de 5.0 en Google que dejaron sus clientes.
parrafo.en: Mini Company Landscaping has spent years transforming yards across Miami-Dade: garden beds, palms and trees, decorative rock and lawn maintenance, with the same care on every visit. Backed by the 5.0 rating customers left on Google.

hero.imagen_alt: Mature queen palms and a fresh landscaping bed installed by Mini Company Landscaping

parrafo_1.es: Mini Company Landscaping and Maintenance es un equipo local que atiende propiedades en todo Miami-Dade, desde patios residenciales hasta propiedades que mantienen ano tras ano. Instalan camas de jardin, palmas, piedra decorativa y se encargan del mantenimiento regular del cesped.
parrafo_1.en: Mini Company Landscaping and Maintenance is a local crew serving properties across Miami-Dade, from residential front yards to properties they maintain year after year. They install garden beds, palms, decorative rock, and handle regular lawn maintenance.

parrafo_2.es: Varios clientes llevan anos trabajando con ellos, incluida una propiedad en los Florida Keys que mantienen desde hace mas de un ano. Responden rapido, trabajan limpio y dejan el patio listo para disfrutarse.
parrafo_2.en: Several clients have worked with them for years, including a property in the Florida Keys they have maintained for over a year. They respond quickly, work clean, and leave the yard ready to enjoy.

titulo.en: Call and tell us about your yard

texto.es: Nos cuentas que necesita tu patio: cesped, camas de jardin, palmas o una renovacion completa.
texto.en: Tell us what your yard needs: lawn care, garden beds, palms, or a full makeover.

texto.es: Pasamos a ver la propiedad y te damos un precio claro segun el trabajo, sin sorpresas.
texto.en: We walk the property and give you a clear price for the work, no surprises.

texto.es: Plantamos, instalamos piedra o renovamos el cesped, cuidando cada detalle y dejando todo recogido.
texto.en: We plant, install rock or renovate the lawn, taking care of every detail and leaving the site clean.

titulo.en: Ongoing care if you want it

texto.es: Muchos clientes nos quedan para el mantenimiento regular: volvemos y tu patio sigue luciendo igual.
texto.en: Many clients keep us on for regular maintenance: we come back and your yard keeps looking the same.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza segun el tamano de la propiedad y lo que necesites. Llamanos y te damos el detalle antes de agendar.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the size of the property and what you need. Call us and we will walk you through it before you book.

texto.es: Diseno e instalacion de camas de jardin con piedra decorativa, arbustos y flores de temporada.
texto.en: Design and installation of garden beds with decorative rock, shrubs and seasonal flowers.

texto.es: Instalamos palmas maduras y arboles de sombra, eligiendo la especie correcta para el espacio.
texto.en: We install mature palms and shade trees, choosing the right species for your space.

texto.es: Corte, bordeado y cuidado regular para que tu patio se mantenga impecable todo el ano.
texto.en: Mowing, edging and regular care to keep your yard looking sharp all year.

texto.es: Acabados en piedra decorativa y reparacion de areas pavimentadas alrededor de la casa.
texto.en: Decorative rock finishes and paver area touch-ups around the house.

pie.es: No ves tu proyecto aqui? Llamanos igual, atendemos casi cualquier trabajo de patio.
pie.en: Do not see your project here? Call us anyway, we handle almost any yard project.

items.quote: I booked Mini Landscaping to rescue my mini backyard. I am not a gardener and decided on pea gravel with a patch of grass for my furry family. Although I was delayed almost 2 months in doing the job, they did an amazing job once it got started.
Mini Co. Landscape has been taking care of my property in the Florida Keys for over a year now. They keep the place looking in top shape. Very nice people, very responsive. Fair price.
This company has been taking care of my lawn for 3 years and they have been great. Highly recommend them for your grass needs.
